notes: Fenn "Jury Reactor": a jury-rigged cream frame holding a round glass jar with a pulsing amber core, four mismatched capacitor cans in the corners (coloured caps that blink in turn), loops of wire and taped joints between them, and two blinking antennas. Damaged: the jar cracked and leaking light, a can hanging off its wire, sparks at a joint. Disabled: the jar dark and split, cans knocked loose, the tape peeled, the antennas bent.
